findings.title: Fallback locales are not loaded outside the controller request path, so fallbacks fail in jobs and mailers
findings.body: With fallbacks enabled, when a key is missing in the current locale the I18n backend walks the fallback chain (user locale, SiteSetting.default_locale, :en). However I18n.translate in the accelerator only calls load_locale(config.locale), so the fallback locales' translation files stay unloaded unless someone explicitly called I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!. That call is only made in ApplicationController#set_locale. Background jobs (Sidekiq), ActionMailer deliveries, rake tasks and console code set I18n.locale directly without ensure_loaded!, so a lookup for a key missing in e.g. :fr will probe :en (or the default locale) while its YAML files are not loaded and will return 'translation missing: fr.xxx' even though the English translation exists. The web UI shows the English fallback while emails/jobs show missing-translation strings. translate should also ensure the fallback locales (I18n.fallbacks[config.locale]) are loaded when fallbacks are configured.

findings.title: Translation cache key ignores SiteSetting.default_locale, so cached fallback results go stale when the default locale changes
findings.body: The LRU cache key is "#{key}#{config.locale}#{config.backend.object_id}". With the new fallback chain, the cached result for a key missing in the user's locale also depends on SiteSetting.default_locale (which is consulted by FallbackLocaleList#[] on every lookup). If an admin changes default_locale at runtime, translations previously resolved through the old default locale remain cached in the process-local LRU cache (size 300, so hot keys persist indefinitely) and users keep seeing the old language until eviction or restart. Nothing invalidates @cache when default_locale changes. The default locale (or a fallback-chain fingerprint) needs to be part of the cache key, or the cache must be flushed when the setting changes.

findings.title: FallbackLocaleList silently discards the standard I18n fallbacks assignment API
findings.body: FallbackLocaleList subclasses Hash but overrides [] to always compute the chain from SiteSetting.default_locale, never consulting stored entries. The documented i18n extension point I18n.fallbacks[locale] = [:xx, :en] (used by plugins and by I18n::Locale::Fallbacks' own defaults mechanism, e.g. mapping language-specific fallbacks like pt to pt-BR) becomes a silent no-op: the assignment succeeds but is never read back. Any plugin relying on that API will appear to work while its fallbacks are ignored. Either delegate to super for explicitly-set locales or document that per-locale fallback registration is unsupported.

findings.title: Fallbacks are now enabled in development/test, masking missing-translation regressions, and the PR ships no tests
findings.body: Previously config.i18n.fallbacks = true was production/profile/cloud66-only; the new initializer enables fallbacks in every environment, including test. As a result, translations missing from a non-English locale now silently render English in the test suite, so tests can no longer detect keys that were not translated or were accidentally removed. On top of that, the PR adds no specs at all for the new behavior: nothing covers FallbackLocaleList ordering (user locale -> default -> en), ensure_loaded!, or that a key missing in the current locale resolves via the fallback chain. Add tests that assert the fallback resolution, and consider asserting on translation-missing detection separately so fallbacks don't hide gaps.
